message: PC is a big boy... he'll get over it. What I'm wondering is this. I've started step one which is to file a complaint with my local public utilities commission, but I also wonder if we should all contact our local ACLU. I visited their site and the final phase of the form asks what we want the ACLU to do. Legally, what realistically can we expect to be delivered from a court? Can the ACLU with it's supremely limited funds take on a class action suit? And do we have grounds against SBC since most T-Netix operators will tell you that the only way to side step the prepaid account is to sign up with SBC? Any clues...
